senses.gloss: f.(b. h. שֹׁקֶת; שָׁקָה)trough, gutter, a grooved stone to receive and carry off the overflow of a well, sink.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Parah 5:8">Tosef. Par. V</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Parah 4:9">IV</cite>), 9 <he>הש׳ שבטיט</he> ed. Zuck. (oth. ed. <he>השוקט</he>, corr. acc.; R. S. to <cite ref="Mishnah Parah 5:7">Par. V, 7</cite> <he>של טיט</he>) a sink which is formed by a rim of clay.
<cite ref="Mishnah Parah 5:7">Ib.</cite> <he>שׁוֹקַעַת שגממיות וכ׳</he> a sink which is surrounded by small cavities, if they are connected with the main sink &c.

<cite ref="Mishnah Parah 6:1">Par. VI, 1</cite>; <cite ref="Sukkah 37a">Succ. 37ᵃ</cite>; a. fr.—[<cite ref="Tosefta Tahorot 10:3">Tosef. Toh. X, 3</cite>, quot. in R. S. to <cite ref="Mishnah Tahorot 9:1">Toh. IX, 1</cite>, v. <cite ref="P01192"><he>עֵקֶל</he></cite>).—Pl. <he>שִׁקְתוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 73">Gen. R. s. 73</cite>; a. e.
